text: The Claude Code ACP adapter coax runs is the standalone release build of `agentclientprotocol/claude-agent-acp` v0.101.0. The release folder holds `claude-agent-acp` and the bundled `claude` it runs from beside itself, and needs no node. The `claude` entry in coax's `config.toml` points at the binary by its full path. Nothing updates it, so a new version means downloading the release tarball again.
